summary: First-run comprehensive testing of Brasil Minis MVP (e-commerce). Backend: 32/32 pytest cases pass across catalog/auth/coupons/orders/favorites/reviews/account/admin RBAC/banners. Frontend E2E: home hero + 15 featured products load, catalog shows 28 seeded products with filters/sort/pagination, product detail (gallery, add-to-cart, buy-now, favorite toggle) works, cart totals + free-shipping progress correct, register->checkout->PIX order flow succeeds (order BM218476 created with BRASIL10 coupon applying R$29.98 discount, PIX QR shown), favorites persisted for logged-in user, admin login redirects to /conta then /admin dashboard renders real stats (R$227.81 revenue, 1 order, 28 products, 3 customers, low-stock warning, revenue chart, recent orders). Admin sidebar shows all 7 sections.

minor.issue: GET /api/products response includes an empty-string brand field for some non-brand items (e.g. Mochila Colecionador). Not a bug but UI shows the label 'VESTUARIO' as fallback; consider always populating brand or hiding.

ui_bugs.issue: Browser tab title is generic 'Emergent | Fullstack App'; should be 'Brasil Minis'

issues: URL stays at /checkout after successful order — refreshing loses the confirmation view. Consider navigating to /pedido/:id or /conta on refresh.

action_items: Update public/index.html <title> to 'Brasil Minis' (and meta description in pt-BR).
Optional: after successful order, redirect to /conta or a dedicated /pedido/:id page so a reload doesn't wipe the confirmation state.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: refresh cookie sets samesite='none' + secure — correct for cross-site preview but requires HTTPS in all environments (OK here).
orders.py: stock decrement happens AFTER order insert without a transaction — under concurrent load could oversell. Consider MongoDB findOneAndUpdate with $inc guard or transactions.
admin.py: create_product falls back to a random-suffixed slug on collision, but update_product does not check slug collisions on rename — could allow duplicate slugs.
reviews.py: no dedup — same user can post unlimited reviews for the same product, skewing rating.
catalog.py: on_sale filter uses compare_at_price > 0 but doesn't verify compare_at_price > price (a promo could be flagged even if not actually cheaper).
server.py: seed_admin only re-hashes when password mismatches — good. However CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; ensure env sets explicit origins in prod.
account.py: uses ObjectId(user['id']) — get_current_user already stores id as str which is fine, but any legacy non-ObjectId ids would break. Acceptable for MVP.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@brasilminis.com / Admin@2025. Test customers were registered dynamically with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Startup seeds 28 products, categories, brands, banners, coupons (BRASIL10/MINIS20/FRETEGRATIS). During test: created several TEST_ users, one confirmed order BM218476 (R$299.72 PIX), and a favorite entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and full E2E purchase flow are green. Address form testids use 'addr-*' prefix (not 'checkout-*'). Registration uses 'register-name/email/password/submit' (no confirm-password field). Checkout confirmation renders in-place at /checkout; do not expect a URL change. Coupon BRASIL10 needs subtotal >= R$100, MINIS20 needs >= R$300.
